title: Automatic backups
description: Saves an encrypted snapshot of your groups on the schedule below while your browser is open. The newest {{count}} are kept.
upgradeDescription: Automatic backups are part of Pro: an encrypted snapshot of your groups, saved on a schedule, with the newest {{count}} kept.
deleteScope: It is removed from this browser and from your account. Another browser that already has it keeps its own copy.
intervalDescription: Only when something changed. The newest {{count}} backups are kept; older ones are removed.
planEnded: Your plan no longer includes automatic backups, so no new ones are made. The ones below are still yours to restore or delete.
howToRestore: How to restore the backup from {{when}}
restoreExplainer: Add keeps your current groups and puts the backup's next to them. Replace makes your groups exactly what this backup holds. Either way you can undo it.
replaceDescription: Your groups will be replaced with the {{backup}} from this backup. You can undo this.
replaceDescriptionLosing_one: Your groups will be replaced with the {{backup}} from this backup. Your {{count}} current group will be removed. You can undo this.
replaceDescriptionLosing_other: Your groups will be replaced with the {{backup}} from this backup. Your {{count}} current groups will be removed. You can undo this.
deleteDescription: The backup from {{when}} will be deleted. {{scope}} This cannot be undone.

download.checking: Checking for backups stored in your account...
download.broughtBack_one: Brought back {{count}} backup stored in your account.
download.broughtBack_other: Brought back {{count}} backups stored in your account.

download.identityChanged: The signed-in account changed while loading backups, so nothing was added. Open Settings again to retry.

outcome.savedLocally: Backup saved on this device. It will upload the next time TabMerger syncs.

skip.tierUnknown: Could not check your plan. Check your connection and try again.
skip.notEntitled: Automatic backups are part of Pro.
skip.identityChanged: The signed-in account changed while backing up, so the backup was stopped. Try again.

toast.unreadable: This backup could not be read
toast.noGroups: This backup has no groups to restore

toast.restored_skipped: Restored {{backup}}, {{skipped}} skipped. Undo brings back what you had.

file.toggle: Also save a file to this computer
file.description: Each backup is also written as a JSON file you can import again. The file is not encrypted: anyone who can open your Downloads folder can read the tabs in it.
file.location: Files go inside your browser's Downloads folder. To use another location, change the browser's download location.
file.retention: TabMerger never deletes these files. Remove old ones yourself when you no longer need them.
file.permissionDenied: TabMerger needs permission to save files. Allow it in the browser prompt to turn this on.
file.permissionRevoked: Turned off: TabMerger no longer has permission to save files. Turn it on to allow it again.
file.whereToFind: To find the files, open your browser's Downloads folder and look in the folder named above (with no folder name, they are directly in Downloads).
file.lastFilePending: The file is still being written.
file.lastFileGone: The last file was moved or deleted, or is no longer in the browser's list of downloads, so TabMerger cannot point to it.
file.showUnavailable: This browser does not let TabMerger open the folder for you. Open your Downloads folder yourself.
file.showFailed: The folder could not be opened. Open your Downloads folder yourself.
file.tokenHelp: You can use {{tokens}}. {{extension}} is added for you.
file.fixField: Fix the highlighted field to see where files will go.
file.noneYet: No file has been saved yet.
